WITH OrderMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        customerID,
        orderDate,
        LAG(orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY customerID ORDER BY orderDate) as prev_order_date
    FROM orders
),
CustomerIntervals AS (
    SELECT 
        customerID,
        AVG(date_diff('day', prev_order_date, orderDate)) as avg_days_between_orders,
        MAX(orderDate) as last_order_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT orderID) as total_orders
    FROM OrderMetrics
    GROUP BY customerID
),
LifetimeRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customerID,
        SUM(od.unitPrice * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) as total_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderID = od.orderID
    GROUP BY o.customerID
)
SELECT 
    c.companyName,
    lr.total_revenue,
    ci.total_orders,
    ci.avg_days_between_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN ci.last_order_date < (SELECT MAX(orderDate) - INTERVAL 180 DAY FROM orders) THEN 'Churned' 
        ELSE 'Active' 
    END as churn_status
FROM customers c
JOIN LifetimeRevenue lr ON c.customerID = lr.customerID
JOIN CustomerIntervals ci ON c.customerID = ci.customerID

WITH OrderMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customerID,
        c.companyName,
        SUM(od.unitPrice * od.quantity) AS total_lifetime_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderID) AS total_orders,
        MAX(o.orderDate) AS last_order_date,
        AVG(date_diff('day', o.orderDate, LEAD(o.orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customerID ORDER BY o.orderDate))) AS avg_days_between_orders
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customerID = o.customerID
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderID = od.orderID
    GROUP BY c.customerID, c.companyName
)
SELECT 
    customerID,
    companyName,
    total_lifetime_revenue,
    total_orders,
    avg_days_between_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN last_order_date < (SELECT MAX(orderDate) FROM orders) - INTERVAL 180 DAY THEN 'Churned' 
        ELSE 'Active' 
    END AS churn_status
FROM OrderMetrics

    c.customerID, 
    c.companyName, 
    SUM(od.unitPrice * od.quantity) AS total_lifetime_revenue, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderID) AS number_of_orders,
    AVG(order_intervals.days_between) AS avg_days_between_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN MAX(o.orderDate) < (SELECT MAX(orderDate) - INTERVAL 180 DAY FROM orders) THEN 'Churned' 
        ELSE 'Active' 
    END AS customer_status
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customerID = o.customerID
JOIN order_details od ON o.orderID = od.orderID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        orderID, 
        customerID, 
        orderDate,
        date_diff('day', LAG(orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY customerID ORDER BY orderDate), orderDate) AS days_between
    FROM orders
) AS order_intervals ON o.orderID = order_intervals.orderID
GROUP BY c.customerID, c.companyName
